title: The Long Game: Light Fingers

texts.details:
Anyone can cut a throat. It takes no skill at all, and it leaves you with a body and no answers.

I am going to teach you the other thing. East of here, where the Defias camp by the river, there is a man named Tobias Rook. He carries messages for people who do not want them read. I want what is in his pocket, $N. I do not want him dead. A dead courier is replaced by morning, and the next one I will not know.

Come at him from behind, unseen, and take it. If he sees you, walk away and try again when he has forgotten.
texts.objectives: Pick the pocket of Tobias Rook, among the Defias east of Goldshire, and bring the Crumpled Note he carries to your trainer. Killing him will not give it to you.
texts.progress: From behind, and quietly. If he is dead you have failed, whatever you bring me.
texts.completion:
He never felt it? Good. That is the trade, $N. Everything else is knife work.

Let me see. "Red stones, two crates. The buyers want them by the tower in Westfall before the moon turns." No names. There never are.

Red stones. That is not copper and it is not gems. I will pass this up to people who are paid to worry. You, meanwhile, have pulled a thread, and in this work one never knows how long a thread is. Take your pick of these. When you have twenty seasons, go to Westfall and find a woman called Kearnen, near the tower in the south-east. Tell her Keryn sent you about the stones.

idea: The Long Game, level 10 (Alliance): lift a note from a smuggler without killing him. The first pull on a thread that leads to the Syndicate. Invented: Tobias Rook and the note.
